title: Runtime Static Borrow
goal: Leak a dynamically generated String to produce a &'static str reference.
hints: Standard stack strings are dropped when the function scope exits.
`Box::leak` forfeits stack cleanup. It promotes heap memory to a `'static` lifetime.
explanation: `Box::leak` takes ownership of `Box<String>`. It forfeits drop cleanup and returns `&'static mut String`. This deref coerces to `&'static str`. Using `&s` creates a reference bound to the local stack frame. This fails with `E0597` because `s` is dropped when the function returns. Calling `boxed.as_str()` or `&boxed` causes `E0515` for returning a reference to a local variable.
